headline: Six Fronts Intensify as Casualties Mount and Bases Trade Hands
war_summary: At day 449 the war remains deadlocked across a handful of decisive corridors. Callahans Passage has now recorded 105,457 Colonial and 98,189 Warden dead, with 363 fresh enlistees in the last two hours and 22 ownership changes, two of them in the most recent window. Weathered Expanse adds 5,331 Colonial and 7,281 Warden casualties in the same span, 187 new recruits and 23 base swaps, four in the last two hours. Nevish Line shows 2,040 Colonial and 1,836 Warden losses, 313 enlistees and 22 flips, two fresh. Stonecradle tallies 3,524 Colonial and 5,106 Warden dead, 316 recruits and 13 exchanges, two recent. Linn Mercy registers 1,032 Colonial and 2,760 Warden casualties, 314 enlistees and five flips, two recent. Mooring County reports 2,491 Colonial and 1,907 Warden dead, 314 recruits and five swaps, one recent. Stlican Shelf and Palantine Berm each saw modest but measurable turnover, while the remainder of the map remains largely static with only low‑level casualty drift and no ownership movement.
